>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Cancels a subscription and records you, the merchant, as the initiator.

`mode: "immediate"` stops the subscription now, stops scheduled charges and retries, and refunds nothing. `mode: "at_period_end"` leaves `status` unchanged and schedules the cancellation. When the next billing date arrives, Ottu cancels the subscription and does not charge. Ottu cancels the next scheduled cycle at once, so `next_billing_date` is `null` while the cancellation is pending.

Ottu refuses `mode: "at_period_end"` with `422 invalid_transition` while a payment is due or in progress: on a `past_due` subscription, or while a cycle is `retry_scheduled`, `processing` or `needs_triage`. It also refuses it while the subscription is `pending_setup` or `setup_failed`. Use `mode: "immediate"` in those cases.

Only you can cancel immediately. A cancellation from the customer's self-service page always takes effect at the end of the paid period.

`cancellation_initiator` records who requested the cancellation: `api_key` for you, `customer` for the customer. When the customer undoes a pending cancellation from the self-service page, Ottu clears it. Read `cancel_at_period_end` and `status` from Retrieve to know whether a cancellation is pending.


<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location --globoff 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel/' \\\n--header 'Idempotency-Key: <uuid>' \\\n--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY' \\\n--data '{\n  \"mode\": \"immediate\"\n}'"}</pre>
